controls.label: Shape
controls.qualification: A sphere of the published radius, lit by Kepler-16; the neutral gray is a display convention, not a measured colour.
controls.notes: No image or colour of this planet exists: it is known from its transits across both stars and from the timing of the stars' eclipses (see the investigation ledger). The gray marks an unresolved surface; the lighting is star A's, at the measured orbit. Star B, 1.5% as bright in Kepler's band, is not added to the lighting.
